messages:
nora: Heads-up: we need a concise launch bench narrative that non-ML folks can grok. Objective: 1) explain latency vs cost tradeoffs across three product slices, 2) give an easy next step per slice (self-serve/demo/enterprise). Ideas?
ethan: Two quick creative directions: A) "slice maps" 10s - a Sankey showing token flows -> compute -> cost buckets by workload; B) "economics horizon" 10s - area chart of cost per 1k tokens at different QPS tiers. Sankey is novel and visual.
priya: Love the Sankey. It makes the invisible token-to-cost flow tangible. For copy: lead with a single sentence: "See how the same API call can cost very different amounts depending on latency SLO and workload." Then 3 panels below: consumer chat, search, rerank with a recommended CTA for each.
carlos: Routing plan: Landing page form has a 1-click quick probe (paste sample prompt or choose workload) -> runs a lightweight simulator and returns estimated p50/p95 + cost range. Heavier enterprises fill company form. Webhook rules: `if estimated_monthly_tokens >= 50M or snr == 'enterprise' -> sales_queue`.
ux-bot: Attached: small placeholder CSV for annotations. Use these numbers only as axis examples and label as "sample data".
``` 
model,workload,latency_p50_ms,latency_p95_ms,cost_per_1k_tokens_usd,qps
lite,consumer_chat,110,260,0.48,50
search-core,search,360,820,0.31,20
sparse-quant,rerank,190,460,0.09,200
```
priya: Visual plan: top left Sankey for token->compute->cost (three lanes for slices). Top right small horizon chart showing cost per 1k tokens vs QPS tiers (steady, burst, heavy). Below: three compact cards (one per slice) with p50/p95, typical sequence length, recommended deployment (hosted/dedicated/private), and CTA: "Try quick probe" / "Run 5-min demo" / "Talk to infra".
ethan: For measurement transparency, include a tiny methodology pill: `test harness: steady-state warm-cache, batch sizes auto, seq len 32/128/64 for the slices, measured at 1s warm-up`. Also add a footnote for <200ms claims: "measured at p50 with <64 history and 10-50 QPS".
nora: Webinar idea: 25m narrative (why economics matter) + 20m live probe demo + 15m customer Q/A. Speakers: priya on narrative, ethan on demo, carlos on routing/ops. Date suggestion: two weeks out.
carlos: Inbound tagging rules (initial draft): `if quick_probe_result.cost_per_1k > 0.4 -> tag:high-econ`, `if quick_probe_result.latency_p95 < 300 and workload == 'consumer_chat' -> tag:low-latency-interest`, `if form.monthly_tokens > 100M -> tag:enterprise`. We'll surface tags to CRM via webhook.
priya: Microcopy tests: Quick-probe CTA: "Estimate latency & cost in 60s"; Demo CTA: "See a live replay on your workload"; Enterprise CTA: "Request a capacity conversation". Keep CTAs short and A/B test phrasing.
ethan: Design note: color-code slices consistently across visuals (chat=teal, search=orange, rerank=indigo). Use subtle motion on Sankey for web.
nora: Action items: 1) ethan = finalize CSV & probe simulator inputs by Wed EOD, 2) priya = draft copy + three cards by Thurs, 3) carlos = webhook + tag mapping doc by Thurs, 4) ux-bot = initial visual mockups by Thurs afternoon. Reconvene Fri 11am to sign off.
priya: I'll also write a 90-second launch post draft that frames the narrative as "visibility into the hidden costs of inference" and ties to our Optimize tooling. Will share by Wed PM.
ethan: Uploaded a bench snapshot to s3: s3://redwood-ops/benchshots/2025-08-02/sankey-sample.csv :link:
nora: Great. Thanks everyone. Short thread but feels actionable. :rocket:
